title: Saudi point-of-sale spending, Q4 2022 vs Q4 2021

attempts.text: In Q4 2022, the Saudi Arabia point-of-sale card spending (SAMA) showed a significant increase of 14.6% compared to the same period in 2021, with an average weekly POS value of SAR 11.01 billion. This growth is attributed to the increase in other categories such as Miscellaneous Goods and Services (up by SAR 336 million), Beverage and Food (up by SAR 247 million), and Electronic & Electric Devices (up by SAR 276 million). However, Furniture saw a decrease of 7.0% in average weekly value, down by SAR 24 million.

issues.detail: Electronic & Electric Devices described as up but its change is down

attempts.text: In Q4 2022, the average weekly POS value increased by 14.6% compared to the same quarter in 2021, reaching SAR 11.01 billion. This significant increase is attributed to the Other category, which saw a 25.0% increase in average weekly value, totaling SAR 1,679 million. The Miscellaneous Goods and Services category also experienced a notable increase, with a 29.3% rise, totaling SAR 1,219 million. These positive changes in Other and Miscellaneous Goods and Services indicate a strong performance in the retail sector.
